chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Hammad ibn Ziyad, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام:
Concerning a man who cut off the withered hand of another man, he said: "Upon him is one-third of the diyah."

key_terms.شَلَّاءَ: withered or paralyzed; describing a disabled hand
key_terms.يَدَ: hand; the injured limb under discussion
key_terms.ٱلدِّيَةِ: diyah; prescribed financial compensation for bodily injury

ai.seo_question: What is the diyah for cutting off a withered hand in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning compensation for cutting off a withered hand. The Imam عليه السلام states that the liability in such a case is one-third of the diyah, indicating a reduced compensation due to the prior condition of the limb.
